github_issue.title: ISS-0601: state_snapshots_test 4 remaining failures predate UUID migration
github_issue.body_excerpt: ISS-0601 sync — see `docs/issues/ISS-0601.json` for full diagnosis. 4 of 9 tests in `tests/integration/iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig` fail with 'POSTGRES ERROR: audit_entries is immutable' followed by 'expected N, found N+1'. Root cause: `src/engine/instance.zig InstanceStore.create()` automatically takes a baseline snapshot at seq=1 — every newly created instance has 1 snapshot. The failing tests (TC-01, TC-02, TC-05, TC-08 v2) were written BEFORE the baseline-snapshot feature and assert off-by-one snapshot counts. The 'audit_entries is immutable' message is red-herring noise from `tests/integration/helpers.zig resetTestData()` — DELETE FROM audit_entries runs BEFORE session_replication_role='replica' is set, and deleteTableBestEffort silently swallows the error.
